invalidates: Any changed subject/pose/path/load/geometry/material/resource/receiver invalidates its dependent evidence; evaluate at entry and completion, never cache READY
failure_rule: Proven blocking FALSE -> BLOCKED even with UNKNOWN elsewhere; otherwise mandatory UNKNOWN/stale/unsupported -> INDETERMINATE; only all current assumptions can be ALLOWED_ASSUMED documentary, never physical permission
faults: Stable independent fault IDs/domain/subject; only targeted confirmation of same entity clears own fault. Rejected operation IDs retained forever including A→B→C→A; recovery new unique ID, own conditions, no universal READY, no clearing other faults.
